en: A colorized panoramic view of a small historic town surrounded by fields or vineyards. In the foreground are rows of vineyard stakes on a hillside, leading down to a compact town with red‑roofed houses, church towers, and several larger civic buildings. The skyline shows multiple church spires and a slightly elevated hill with buildings on the left. The card is worn, with creases and torn patches near the top. Printed captions appear along the top margin, including a multilingual place name on the left and something like a view description on the right.
